09-17-1499 is September 17, 1499.  
255 days later:  
From Sep 17 to Dec 31, 1499: 14 (Sep) + 31 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 106 days.  
255 - 106 = 149 days into 1500.  
1500 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 400? 1500 divisible by 4 but not by 400 → not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30: 31+28+31+30 = 120 days.  
149 - 120 = 29 days into May → May 29, 1500.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1500-05-29
